pages.headline: Disk Saver
pages.description: Pinokio Disk Saver finds byte-identical files across apps and lets them share physical storage, reclaiming disk space without changing their paths.
pages.ogImageAlt: Pinokio Disk Saver works across AI apps, package ecosystems, and operating systems
